title: TerminalClippingConvex.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize a measurable convex function on a nonempty closed convex domain C in Euclidean space. A minimizer x* exists with ||x0-x*||≤R. Neither differentiability, smoothness, strong convexity, nor boundedness of C is required.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Stochastic subgradient oracle g(x,ξ): its mean satisfies f(x)-f(y)≤⟨E[g(x,ξ)],x-y⟩ for every x,y∈C. Oracle seeds are IID; individual replies need not be subgradients.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: Exact Euclidean projection onto C, equivalently the proximal operator of its indicator. Each projection query counts as one oracle call, as does each stochastic subgradient query.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/TerminalClippingConvex.lean: Query.projection and spec.admissible projection inequalities; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: Only finite second moments are imposed: E||g(x,ξ)||²≤B²||x-x0||²+G² for x∈C. Heavy-tailed replies are permitted; no exponential-tail or uniform variance bound is assumed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Ambient space is R^d with its Euclidean inner product and norm; d is public.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The second-moment growth is anchored at x0. Public information is d,x0,B,G,δ,T; R,ε and the sample space are hidden. B,G>0, R≥0, ε>0, 0<δ<1, T≥1, and [2^20(BR²+G²/B)log(8/δ)]²≤Tε².
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/TerminalClippingConvex.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.valid and spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable output x with f(x)-f(x*)≤ε on the success event. The specification does not require a last iterate or forbid averaging.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The output must belong to C for every seed, including outcomes outside the objective-accuracy success event.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P(f(output)-f(x*)>ε)≤δ, under the joint algorithm and oracle randomness.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Convex stochastic optimization with projections is classical, but the anchored, distance-dependent second-moment bound, hidden solution radius, and high-probability guarantee form a meaningful variant of standard uniformly bounded-moment formulations.

descriptionHtml:
Terminal Clipping for Convex Minimization

We consider minimizing a measurable convex function f:Rd→R over a closed convex set D, with a given x0∈D within distance R≥0 of a minimizer x⋆. The oracle returns stochastic subgradient estimates g(x,ξ) from independent samples ξ with law ν, or exact projections onto D. Their means are subgradients on D, and Eξ∼ν∥g(x,ξ)∥2≤B2∥x−x0∥2+G2, where B,G>0. Projected clipped updates must return a measurable terminal iterate x¯∈D satisfying f(x¯)−f(x⋆)≤ε with probability at least 1−δ, where ε>0 and δ∈(0,1).

The optimization problem is minx∈Df(x). Here d is a nonnegative integer, and ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ and ∥⋅∥ denote the Euclidean inner product and norm. The algorithm receives d,x0,B,G,δ,R,ε and accesses the objective and constraint set through the oracle.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity and initial distance). The set D⊆Rd is closed and convex, x0∈D, and f is measurable on Rd. For all x,y∈D and t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y). There exists x⋆∈D such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈D,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

Assumption 2 (Stochastic subgradients). Let ν be a probability measure on a measurable sample space Ω. The map g:Rd×Ω→Rd is jointly measurable. For every x∈D, g(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable and ∥g(x,⋅)∥2 is integrable under ν. Its mean satisfies the subgradient inequality f(x)−f(y)≤⟨Eξ∼ν[g(x,ξ)],x−y⟩,x,y∈D, and its second moment satisfies Eξ∼ν[∥g(x,ξ)∥2]≤B2∥x−x0∥2+G2,x∈D. The oracle samples form a sequence (ξk)k≥0 of measurable, mutually independent random variables, each with law ν. This sequence is independent of the algorithm’s randomness. At call k, a subgradient query at x returns g(x,ξk).

Assumption 3 (Exact projection). A projection query at any z∈Rd returns ΠD(z), where ΠD:Rd→Rd is measurable and satisfies ΠD(z)∈D,⟨z−ΠD(z),u−ΠD(z)⟩≤0,u∈D.

Our formulation is algorithm-specific: we analyze terminal clipping with projected stochastic subgradient updates. For a nonnegative threshold C, define clipC(v)={v,∥v∥≤C,C∥v∥v,∥v∥>C. The method starts at the given x0, with initial output x0 and first query a subgradient query at x0. It alternates subgradient and projection queries. Before receiving the subgradient reply at iteration t, it selects a step size ηt≥0 and threshold Ct≥0 using its available history and internal randomness. The updates are gt=g(xt,ξ2t),zt=xt−ηtclipCt(gt),xt+1=ΠD(zt). The output remains xt after the subgradient reply and becomes xt+1 after the projection reply; the next query is a subgradient query at xt+1. Both query types count toward a single total oracle-call budget. Thus each completed update uses two calls. With a budget of N≥0 calls, the terminal output is x¯=x⌊N/2⌋; an unmatched final subgradient call leaves it unchanged.

The required output is measurable and belongs to D for every realization. Its accuracy requirement is PP(f(x¯)−f(x⋆)>ε)≤δ, where P is the joint law of the oracle samples and the independent algorithm randomness.

comparisonHtml:
Measurable f is convex on closed convex X⊆Rd; x0,x⋆∈X, x⋆∈arg⁡minXf, and ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R. IID samples have law ν and joint law P. The jointly measurable oracle satisfies ∫g(x,ω)dν(ω)∈∂Xf(x) and ∫∥g(x,ω)∥2dν(ω)≤B2∥x−x0∥2+G2 on X; exact measurable projection onto X is available. Here B,G,ε>0, R≥0, 0<δ<1. The setup restricts algorithms to projected clipped subgradient updates with the current iterate as output. Target: P{f(xT)−f(x⋆)>ε}≤δ.

import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2

open MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.TerminalClippingConvex

open OracleTemplate

noncomputable def clipReply {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (B : ℝ) (v : E) : E := if ‖v‖ ≤ B then v else (B / ‖v‖) • v

abbrev Vector (d : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

instance (d : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace (Vector d) := borel _
instance (d : ℕ) : BorelSpace (Vector d) := ⟨rfl⟩

structure Public where
  d : ℕ
  x0 : Vector d
  B : ℝ
  G : ℝ
  δ : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

structure Params extends Public where
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]

attribute [instance] Params.measurableΩ

structure Instance (q : Public) where
  f : Vector q.d → ℝ
  domain : Set (Vector q.d)

inductive Query (q : Public) where
  | subgradient : Vector q.d → Query q
  | projection : Vector q.d → Query q

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Public
  Instance := Instance
  Query := Query
  Reply q := Vector q.d
  Output q := Vector q.d
  publicInput q := q.toPublic
  allowedAlgorithm q A :=
    ∃ (η C : A.State → ℝ),
      (∀ s, 0 ≤ η s ∧ 0 ≤ C s) ∧
      (∀ seed, A.output (A.initial seed) = q.x0 ∧
        A.query (A.initial seed) = (0, .subgradient q.x0)) ∧
      ∀ s, match (A.query s).2 with
        | .subgradient x =>
          x = A.output s ∧ ∀ g,
            A.output (A.update s g) = x ∧
            A.query (A.update s g) = (0, .projection (x - η s • clipReply (C s) g))
        | .projection _ => ∀ x,
            A.output (A.update s x) = x ∧
            A.query (A.update s x) = (0, .subgradient x)
  valid q := 0 < q.B ∧ 0 < q.G ∧ 0 < q.δ ∧ q.δ < 1 ∧ 0 ≤ q.R ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q I O :=
    ∃ (g : Vector q.d → q.Ω → Vector q.d) (projection : Vector q.d → Vector q.d)
      (ν : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
    LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k)
      (ν : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (_, query) seed => match query with
            | .subgradient x => g x seed
            | .projection x => projection x } ∧
    Convex ℝ I.domain ∧ IsClosed I.domain ∧ q.x0 ∈ I.domain ∧
    ConvexOn ℝ I.domain I.f ∧ Measurable I.f ∧
    (∃ xstar ∈ I.domain, IsMinOn I.f I.domain xstar ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R) ∧
    Measurable projection ∧
    (∀ x, projection x ∈ I.domain) ∧
    (∀ x, ∀ u ∈ I.domain, ⟪x - projection x, u - projection x⟫ ≤ 0) ∧
    Measurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ I.domain, Integrable (g x) (ν : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ I.domain, ∀ y ∈ I.domain,
      I.f x - I.f y ≤ ⟪∫ ω, g x ω ∂(ν : Measure _), x - y⟫) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ I.domain, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω‖ ^ 2) (ν : Measure _)) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ I.domain, (∫ ω, ‖g x ω‖ ^ 2 ∂(ν : Measure _)) ≤
      q.B ^ 2 * ‖x - q.x0‖ ^ 2 + q.G ^ 2)
  successful q I output P :=
    Measurable output ∧ (∀ ω, output ω ∈ I.domain) ∧
    ∃ xstar ∈ I.domain, IsMinOn I.f I.domain xstar ∧
      (P : Measure _) {ω | q.ε < I.f (output ω) - I.f xstar} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal q.δ

end LongTails.Setups.TerminalClippingConvex
